## Coaching Points

- Maintain a constant head, body, and arm position throughout the entire lift
- Avoid arching the back to complete the lift

## Bent-Over Raises

Exercise Objective: Isolate and develop strength in the posterior deltoids

## Start Position

1. Stand erect with a dumbbell in each hand
2. Let arms hang to the sides to the thighs, and pull shoulder blades back and down
3. Position the feet hip-width apart with toes pointed straight ahead
4. Engage the core and push hips back to transfer weight to the heels
5. Back should be parallel with the ground
6. The dumbbells will hang in front of the body with arms extended, palms facing each other, and shoulder blades pulled back and down
